beats.ko: 손을 올리면 저절로 움직인다는 판, 들어보셨죠?
beats.en: You've heard of the board that moves by itself?

beats.ko: 백 년 전 미국에서 정식으로 등록된 물건입니다.
beats.en: It was formally registered in America a century ago.

beats.ko: 알파벳과 숫자가 적힌 나무판, 그리고 삼각대.
beats.en: A wooden board of letters and numbers, and a pointer.

beats.ko: 손을 살짝 올리면 삼각대가 글자를 짚습니다.
beats.en: Rest your hands on it and the pointer picks out letters.
The papers put it this way.
"The table will move and form sentences."
Who moves it, they never wrote down.
A woman asked the board its name.
The title on the papers: "Toy or Game."

beats.ko: 큰돈을 번 건 만든 사람이 아니었습니다.
beats.en: The one who got rich was not the maker.

beats.ko: 공장 도장공이 회사를 넘겨받아 백만장자가 됐죠.
beats.en: A factory painter took the company and made millions.
The woman who named it was erased from the record.

beats.ko: 그날 그녀 목엔 소설가 '위다'의 초상이 있었습니다.
beats.en: That day she wore a locket of the novelist Ouida.

beats.ko: 이 판의 이름은 위저보드, 분신사바와 뿌리가 같죠.
beats.en: This is the Ouija board - same root as Kokkuri-san.
